findings: Raised face, mirrored orientation, composition and spacing are separate steps; distributed is return to cases after use, not a synonym for composition.
Leading is explicitly line separation rather than margin or word spacing. Typeface is design, not printed wording.
Unused fragile, grain, margin, uniformly and variable were checked across all slots; no actual printing tools or image is required.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher/learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: faces standing above bases定义raised凸起。fragile易碎、variable可变、mirrored镜像均不表示高于底座；其余词词性或义不符。
left right reversed for normal reading印迹需mirrored镜像。raised高度不说明左右，spaced为隔开、inked为上墨、locked为锁紧均非方向反转。
arranging separate pieces required order定义composed排组。distributed是回分各格，与当前组线相反，spaced仅增间隔非完成字序，其他项不表排字。
apart with blank pieces说明spaced留间距。composed泛排字不特指词间空隙，distributed回放、locked固定均非用空件隔词的动作。
material separate lines vertically直接定义leading行间铅条。margin为页边非行间，grain纸或木纹、typeface字形设计均不指纵向行距材料。
so pieces would not move要求locked固定锁紧。inked上墨不防位置移动，mirrored反向、distributed分回均非锁版，其他词不合。
before sheet pressed faces需inked上墨。locked固定不提供墨，raised凸面是原结构，distributed收字不是印前处理；其他项不表着墨。
result pressed sheet printed mark为impression印迹。typeface设计、leading材料、margin页边、grain纹理均非这次压印得到的完整结果。
back storage assigned places returned说明distributed分回。composed是组成版、spaced隔开、locked锁紧、inked上墨，均不表示结束后各归字格。
design letter shapes直接定义typeface字体设计。grain材料纹、margin页边、leading行距、impression印迹均不是字形风格本身。

findings: Support slide and overlying cover are distinct. Objective lens, magnification, focus, resolution and contrast each have a separate definition.
Preparation and illumination are not interchangeable, and larger image size is not equated with greater resolution.
Unused coarse, inverted, overlap, transmitted and transparent were checked against all slots; no specimen image is needed because every tested property is textual.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher/learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: flat glass support on stage定义slide载玻片。cover是上方薄盖而非下托，objective镜头、focus对焦、contrast对比度均不是承托平板。
for observation rather dirty storage说明prepared制备过。illuminated是受光不表示样品先处理，inverted倒置、transmitted传递均非此准备工序。
thin glass over sample定义cover盖片。slide是下托，第1空明确占用；objective是物镜不盖住样品，其他词不命名这一上层玻璃。
by instrument light直接指illuminated照明。prepared制备不等于照亮，transmitted为透射传递不以viewing area为这句被照受体，其他项无此义。
lens nearest specimen定义objective物镜。focus调焦、magnification放大率、resolution分辨率均为光学属性或调整非该镜头名。
how much larger image appears定义magnification放大率。resolution可分细节、contrast明暗差、focus焦面都不等于物像大小比例。
adjustment relevant plane clear定义focus对焦。contrast区分背景、resolution分离细节不是调整焦面动作，magnification改变尺度也不保证清楚。
ability separate close details定义resolution分辨率。magnification只是放大，focus焦面调整、overlap重叠、contrast差异不等同分辨相邻点能力。
difference specimen background定义contrast对比度。focus调焦、magnification放大、resolution细节区分都不是背景区别本身；其他词不合释义。
unwanted material on slide tool定义contamination污染。overlap重叠可能源于样品排布但不等于外来异物，其他候选不命名材料混入问题。

findings: Basket representation is limited to a stated purchase pattern. Base period and comparable product quality are distinct comparison requirements.
Aggregate measure, weighted contributions and basket composition are separate design choices. Substitution is a consumer response, updating an index procedure.
Inflation refers to the measured price level, not every household or welfare. Unused expenditure, nominal, volatility, welfare and yield were checked against all gaps.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher/learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: selection goods services for index称basket篮子。expenditure为支出量、composition为组成属性、base为参照期、welfare福利不指那组具体入选商品服务。
of stated purchases not each household说明representative有代表性。comparable可比不表代表群体，nominal名义、weighted加权均不是对目标购买模式代表关系。
named reference period定义base基期。composition构成、aggregate总量、volatility波动均不指参照时间，其他词词性或义不合。
across time且防包装产品改变误比要求comparable可比。representative代表性不保证同质，nominal名义、weighted加权均不说明跨时同口径。
combined changes rather unrelated prices定义aggregate综合汇总。nominal未作购买力调整不等于多价合成，weighted只指权重设计，其他候选不直接表总体合并。
according shares major expense不同贡献定义weighted加权。aggregate为汇总属性非每项按占比操作，nominal名义、representative代表性不表示赋相对权数。
selected mix及basket changes说明composition构成。expenditure支出金额、volatility波动、welfare福利不直接指入篮项目组合；其他名词不合。
replacing expensive item alternative定义substitution替代。update更新程序、yield产出、expenditure开支均不指改买别物行为。
basket revision improve relevance定义update更新。yield为产生不是改篮，其他候选无to后这种使选样合时的原形动词。
rise measured price level直接定义inflation价格通胀。volatility上下波动不一定上涨，welfare整体福利、expenditure所花金额、base基期均非总体物价升。

findings: The context comparison is fictional and does not claim private forms guarantee truthfulness. Candid is separate from anonymous identity protection.
Conform and socially desirable describe norm pressure; sensitive topic reluctance is separate from misunderstanding.

Framing, neutral wording, recall, nonresponse and validity concern different stages or properties of evidence. Unused anonymous, context, disclosure, prompt and spontaneously were checked against all slots.

how wording presents choice perspective定义framing框架措辞。context广泛情境、prompt单提示、disclosure披露、recall回想均非这个问题呈现角度过程。
praising behaviour makes less neutral中立。anonymous无名、candid坦率、desirable合期许都不直接表示题目不偏袒任一行为；其他项不合。
remember yesterday or year定义recall回忆。nonresponse无答、validity效度、disclosure披露均不是检索过去记忆的过程。
no answer given直接定义nonresponse未回应。disclosure是披露内容，context情境、recall回想都不指空答状态。
